faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Calico Domestic (phenotype)?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 7-12 lb (3-5.5 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a senior Calico Domestic (phenotype)?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Dental disease; Obesity; Chronic kidney disease (senior). Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Calico Domestic (phenotype) at this stage?
faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Calico Domestic (phenotype), sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
